title: AGENTS.md references dropped gossipsub
description: AGENTS.md lines 63 and 79 still state 'Gossipsub topics are per-hierarchy, not per-group' and 'No gossipsub code outside transit' as architectural non-negotiables. Gossipsub was dropped in commit bcd4026. A new contributor reading AGENTS.md would believe gossipsub is a live requirement, and might resist or question changes that correctly have nothing to do with it. Remove or replace with the actual transit protocol (IHAVE/TAKETHIS over TCP peering sessions).
